title: Broken guard in a function the change touched but the claim does not name
claim: parsePort in src/config.mjs now rejects out-of-range input instead of returning a nonsense number: it accepts only integers within the valid TCP port range and throws RangeError otherwise. test/config.test.mjs covers the new rejections and passes.
changeCommitMessage: fix(config): validate parsePort and parseTimeout input

defect.summary: parseTimeout, changed by the same commit but absent from the claim, joins its guard with `&&` instead of `||`, so -5, 1.5 and NaN all pass through.
